title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Approving the Designation of the Zhengzhou Airport Economy Comprehensive Experimental Zone People's Court and the Guancheng Hui District People's Court of Zhengzhou to Have Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Dispute Cases
keywords_en: copyright; trademark right; intellectual property rights; court jurisdiction over certain intellectual property disputes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply on Approving the Designation of the People's Court of Zhengzhou Airport Economy Comprehensive Experimental Zone and the Guancheng Hui District People's Court of Zhengzhou to Have Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Dispute Cases

Fa [2019] No. 70

High People's Court of Henan Province:

Your Request for Instructions on Designating the People's Court of Zhengzhou Airport Economy Comprehensive Experimental Zone and the Guancheng Hui District People's Court of Zhengzhou to Have Jurisdiction over Certain First-Instance Intellectual Property Dispute Cases (Yu Gao Fa [2018] No. 352) has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:

1. It is approved that the People's Court of Zhengzhou Airport Economy Comprehensive Experimental Zone shall have jurisdiction over the following intellectual property cases: first-instance intellectual property civil cases involving disputes over copyrights and trademark rights that occur within the jurisdictional areas of the Erqi District, High-tech Zone, Airport Zone, and Zhongmu County of Zhengzhou, as well as Xinzheng City, Xinmi City, and Dengfeng City, where the amount in controversy is RMB 500,000 or less.

2. It is approved that the Guancheng Hui District People's Court of Zhengzhou shall have jurisdiction over the following intellectual property cases: first-instance intellectual property civil cases involving disputes over copyrights and trademark rights that occur within the jurisdictional areas of the Guancheng Hui District, Jinshui District, Zhongyuan District, Huiji District, and Shangjie District of Zhengzhou, as well as Gongyi City and Xingyang City, where the amount in controversy is RMB 500,000 or less.

It is so replied.

March 18, 2019
